title: Hazmat entry team briefing
description: Briefing for a hazardous materials entry team before it goes into the hot zone: objective, material and hazards as known, the level of protection, the monitoring plan, time limits, communications, abort criteria and the backup team. Decision level only; no entry techniques.

agency.description: Agency or unit that keeps this record.

incidentName.description: Incident name as command announced it.
examples: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom. Defaults to the standard exercise marking.

objective.description: What the team is to accomplish.
examples: Confirm the valve position at the dome and close it if safe, then report.

hazards.description: What is known and unknown about the material.
examples: Corrosive liquid and vapor; shipping paper gives the product name. Container pressure unknown.

monitoring.description: Readings or events that end the entry.
examples: Abort on a monitor reading above the agreed action level, a wind shift toward the team, loss of radio contact, or one team member at half air.
